syllabus_topics: Life cycle of a technical product
General approach in the design process of a technical product
General considerations in the modular design of machines and installations
Design of machines and installations in accordance with environmental protection norms
Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) in the design phase
Laboratory – Design of machines and installations
Project – Elements of design and CAD modeling of a hydraulic cylinder

assessment_methods.method: Homework project presentation and CAD modeling test
Project submission (calculation documentation and CAD model of a hydraulic cylinder)

assessment_rules: The evaluation includes a homework project presentation and a 10-minute CAD modeling test (50%), cumulative laboratory activity assessment (25%), and submission of the calculation documentation and CAD model for a hydraulic cylinder (25%). Minimum performance requires developing a technical project from an idea, verified during the homework project presentation, and CAD modeling skills, verified during laboratory activities and the project.
bibliography: Anghel Cernescu, Proiectarea Mașinilor si Instalațiilor in Inginerie Mecanica, Editura Politehnica Timisoara, ISBN 978-606-554-318-8, 2011
